source_text: Non reliquit superstitem — perfecta victoria. In nobis ne respiret cogitatio mala. Requies post bella completa.
pass_a_gloss: Not he-left survivor — perfect victory. In us lest breathe thought evil. Rest after wars completed.
pass_b_english: [[He left no survivor >> Bible:Joshua 10:40]] — complete victory. In us let no evil thought draw breath. Rest follows finished wars.
